_rules: Every engine must say these the same way in every video. Founder to confirm 'Qubirex' before Phase 1 voicing.
how: Use the TTS engine's custom-pronunciation feature if supported (IPA). Otherwise send the say_en spelling in the TTS text. After rendering, the QA transcript must show the brand the same way at every mention.
engine_note: Gemini TTS has no custom-pronunciation field (Chirp 3 HD, which has one, is not reachable with API keys), so the tts_en / tts_te spelling is sent; every brand mention in a video is then the same recorded clip.
